# Generalization_Bound_Spectra

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
Theoretical bounds on the generalization error of Hebbian networks expressed in terms of the spectral gap or spectral norm of the weight matrix. Offers a quantitative target for tuning synaptic plasticity in iNEST hardware, ensuring robust performance in dynamic, resource-constrained environments.
